acceptance.workspaceRoot: Passed to builder.build in verify() and runReconcile(); Batch 22 exemption now active.
acceptance.retired: source.retired ?? NO_RETIRED_SOURCES threaded into target.plan(..., signal, retired); no second retired filter.
acceptance.manifest: mergeEntries drops removed and keptRetired (disown); writeFailed entries (with itemId) stay owned; lock unchanged.
acceptance.health: appliedTargetHealth gains required workspaceRoot param; removedRetired/keptRetired merged and de-duplicated by harnessPathIdentity(workspaceRoot, relPath).
tests: passes the workspace root to both builder.build calls (verify and reconcile)
activates the workspace skills.sh exemption: this workspace's own root bypasses an empty selection, another workspace's does not
mixed pass: one skill and one MCP key removed, one of each kept and disowned, one MCP key failed and kept owned; the retry removes it; a third pass is a no-op
late-discovered workspace: a workspace first reconciled after the retirement gets its own copies proven and removed, under its own identity
without a retired registry an orphaned copy is an ordinary removal with no retirement outcome
